# Account Hub captures resource URLs rather than visible labels

Entry 1382 adds data-url to sync checkboxes and filters the original discovered arrays using the checked enabled inputs. Calendars compare uri.spec and address books compare url.href. Identical display names can still identify different resources, so preserve URL identity in this capture path. This is a scoped selection contract; normalized URL equivalence and duplicate-resource behavior were not tested. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.

Scope: Account Hub sync resource identity.
